storedHere.title: Stored on this computer
storedHere.keywords: search index cache disk size storage delete full text
storedHere.switchLabel: Keep a search index on this computer
storedHere.switchCaption: Lets search find words inside every document, and lets a folder you opened before open without reading every file again. The index holds file paths and modified times, each document's words with their positions, so its text can be pieced back together, and each document's info block at the top of the file, title, short first paragraph and the list of documents it links to. All of it is rebuilt from the folder's files. It stays in this computer's cache folder and never leaves it; anyone who can read your user account's cache folder can read it. Turning this off or pressing Delete removes it, and a folder's index is also deleted when you take the folder off the list or leave it unopened for two weeks. With search by meaning, the index also holds a list of numbers for each passage, from which parts of its text can be guessed.
storedHere.sizeThisFolder: {size} for this folder. Delete removes this folder's index and its search by meaning; the index is built again the next time you open the folder.
